altTitles.pt-br: Isekai Executioner: O Assassino em Série em Outro Mundo
O Assassino em Série em Outro Mundo
O Serial Killer Reencarnado no Outro Mundo

altTitles.es-la: Un asesino serial ha descendido a otro mundo

description.de: Ein Mörder, der den Drang, Menschen zu töten, nicht stoppen kann, obwohl er damit aufhören will, erhält das von ihm gewünschte Todesurteil. Seine Freude ist nur von kurzer Dauer, denn er wird in einer anderen Welt reinkarniert. Der Auftrag, den ihm die Göttin erteilt hat, besteht darin, 12 reinkarnierte Menschen mit seinen mörderischen Impulsen zu töten. Nicht alle reinkarnierten Menschen sind Heilige!
description.en:
A murderer who can't stop the urge to kill people, even though he wants to stop, is happy when his desired death sentence is carried out - only to be reincarnated into another world. The mission entrusted to him by the goddess was to kill 12 reincarnated people using his murderous impulses! Not all reincarnated people are saints!
___
**Notes:**
- With the debut of the spinoff series, it was revealed that "Hitotsubu Ichigo" (the credited author) was actually an alias of Kawamoto Homura.
- Won the Rakuten Kobo Ebook Award 2024 Special Award.
___
**Official English:** [emaqi - United States & Canada only!](https://emaqi.com/manga/isekai-executioner-the-serial-killer-in-another-world)
description.ja: 止めたいのに人を殺したい衝動が止まらない殺人鬼の男は、望んでいた死刑が執行されて喜んだのも束の間、異世界転生してしまう。女神から託された使命は、男の殺人衝動を活かして12人の転生者を殺すことだった！転生者が聖者とは限らない！
description.pt-br: Um assassino que não consegue controlar o impulso de matar pessoas, mesmo querendo parar, fica feliz quando a sentença de morte desejada é cumprida – apenas para ser reencarnado em outro mundo. A missão confiada a ele pela deusa era matar 12 pessoas reencarnadas usando seus impulsos homicidas! Nem todas as pessoas reencarnadas são santas!
